notes.title: Version 1.01 Update
notes.notes: [p]First off, a huge [b]thank you to the community[/b] for jumping into Trigger Land, sharing feedback, and helping us track down issues so quickly. Your support has been incredible, and it means a lot as we continue shaping the game together.[/p][h3]What’s New in v1.01[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fixed[/b]: NPC footsteps bug where sounds stayed active after death.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ongoing (Top Priority)[/b]: Implemented changes to reduce the game freeze issue when players die — we’re monitoring closely and will continue improving this.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted[/b]: Enemy spawn timers for faster, more intense rounds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated[/b]: Wave pool data for better balance and variety.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p]Melee damage increased from [b]20 → 25[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged units now deal [b]10–20 damage[/b] (previously flat 15).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy aim cone spread changed from a fixed [b]25°[/b] to a dynamic [b]10°–30°[/b] for more natural accuracy.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Coming Next Month [/h3][list][*][p][b]Boss Waves[/b]: Powerful enemies with higher health and unique weapons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Map[/b]: The [b]Arizona Mountains[/b], a rugged new environment packed with fresh challenges.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all again for playing, leaving reviews, and being part of this journey. Every bit of feedback helps us make Trigger Land the best it can be. Stay tuned — we’re just getting started![/p][p]– The Zachery Studios Team[/p]

notes.title: Launch Week Update 2
notes.notes: [h3]Dev Update[/h3][list][*][p][b]Respawn Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improvements made to address the freeze issue on respawn.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Map Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed certain pickups from [i]The Island[/i] map (feature announcement coming soon).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed office door height, misaligned exit doors, and collision issues on the [i]Bowling Alley[/i] map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating items and improved AI pathing on the [i]Village[/i] map.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced enemy health increase per round from [b]15 → 8[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced weapons:[/p][list][*][p]AK74M: [b]55 → 33[/b][/p][/*][*][p]MP5: [b]34 → 29[/b][/p][/*][*][p]G36C: [b]40 → 37[/b][/p][/*][*][p]AKMS: [b]46 → 51[/b][/p][/*][*][p]UMP: [b]29 → 36[/b][/p][/*][*][p]SCAR: [b]44 → 58[/b][/p][/*][*][p]M4 DMR: [b]40 → 60[/b][/p][/*][*][p]AUG: [b]44 → 55[/b][/p][/*][*][p]1911: [b]31 → 41[/b][/p][/*][*][p]1911 mag size: [b]7 → 10[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Intermission Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced intermission time from [b]10s → 8s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where intermission wouldn’t trigger.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Wave System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new starting wave pools so the same 5 levels won’t repeat each game.[/p][/*][*][p]Starting pools will not be reused in the main pools.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Availability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added lower-end weapons to all maps.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Backend Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a few miscellaneous bugs to improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up backend code for better stability and efficiency.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Day one update
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m beyond excited to officially launch our very first game, TriggerLand! [/p][p]This has been a crazy ride and I want to thank everyone who has wishlisted, shared, tested, or supported us along the way. Your feedback and encouragement made this possible, and I’m truly grateful.[/p][p]As with any launch, a few bugs slipped through. I’m already working on patches to smooth things out, and I’ll be pushing hotfixes as quickly as possible. If you run into anything, please drop a note in the community hub or send me feedback—I’ll be listening closely and making updates.[/p][p]This is just the start. I’ve got plans for free updates, new content, and ongoing improvements as we build this game together.[/p][p]Thanks again for being part of TriggerLand’s launch day.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Fix a few bugs with the buy station. [/p][/*][*][p]Added an intermission in-between waves[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AR4 Muzzle Flash[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced the enemy wave pools to scale more properly [/p][/*][*][p]Reduced spawn rate of enemy's[/p][/*][*][p]Added new enemy wave pools[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
